entities.summary: Codi Tyree Miller-McIntyre is an American-born naturalized Bulgarian professional basketball player for KK Crvena Zvezda of the ABA League and the EuroLeague. He also represents the Bulgarian national team internationally. He is the third player in EuroLeague history to record a triple-double. Miller-McIntyre played four years of college basketball for Wake Forest University.
